requirements.constraint_text: Unit of Work required

requirements.statement: Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date is included in eWIC Balance Inquiry, Authorization, and Purchase Completion Responses.
requirements.condition_trigger: Transaction is eWIC Balance Inquiry, Authorization, or Purchase Completion Response
requirements.expected_behavior: Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date included
requirements.constraint_text: Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date included

requirements.statement: Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date format is CCYYMMDD, 8 bytes.
requirements.expected_behavior: Format CCYYMMDD, length 8 bytes
requirements.constraint_text: Format CCYYMMDD, length 8 bytes

requirements.statement: Segment Length value (078) identifies the length in bytes of the Standard Message Data Segment, including field separators.
requirements.expected_behavior: Segment Length must equal actual segment byte length including separators
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length must equal actual segment byte length including separators

requirements.statement: Card Discretionary Block Data identifies card expiration date used in manual entry, max length 51.
requirements.expected_behavior: Max length 51 bytes
requirements.constraint_text: Max length 51 bytes

requirements.statement: Segment Length field identifies the length (017 bytes) of the Variable Information Data Segment, including Field Separators.
requirements.expected_behavior: Segment Length = 017 bytes
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length = 017 bytes

requirements.statement: AVS Information Table Data has max length 29, first 9 characters are ZIP or ZIP+4.
requirements.expected_behavior: First 9 chars = ZIP(5)+4 spaces or ZIP+4(9); remaining 00-20 chars = street address
requirements.constraint_text: First 9 chars = ZIP(5)+4 spaces or ZIP+4(9); remaining 00-20 chars = street address

requirements.statement: Loyalty Information Unit of Work maximum length is 19 numeric.
requirements.expected_behavior: Maximum length = 19n
requirements.constraint_text: Maximum length = 19n

requirements.statement: If no value has been stored at the device, default value of 1249 is sent for Card Expiration Date.
requirements.expected_behavior: Default value 1249 is sent
requirements.constraint_text: Default value 1249 is sent

requirements.statement: Depending on transaction context, Card Expiration Date value can be either MMYY or YYMM format.
requirements.expected_behavior: Value format is MMYY or YYMM
requirements.constraint_text: Value format is MMYY or YYMM

requirements.statement: Shipping address DETAIL consists of 28-character street address followed by 9-digit zip code.
requirements.expected_behavior: 28 char address + 9 digit zip = 37 char DETAIL
requirements.constraint_text: 28 char address + 9 digit zip = 37 char DETAIL

requirements.statement: Payment Token Expiration Date is populated in the PAN Expiration Date field during transaction processing.
requirements.expected_behavior: Token expiration date maps to PAN Expiration Date field
requirements.constraint_text: Token expiration date maps to PAN Expiration Date field

requirements.statement: On all subsequent transactions, unencrypted expiration date should be sent in Data Element 12, Card Discretionary Block Data.
requirements.expected_behavior: Unencrypted expiration date sent in Element 12 as for non-TransArmor transactions
requirements.constraint_text: Unencrypted expiration date sent in Element 12 as for non-TransArmor transactions

requirements.statement: Encrypted data for a manually entered PAN should be followed by <fs> and unencrypted MMYY expiration date.
requirements.expected_behavior: Append <fs> then unencrypted MMYY expiration date
requirements.constraint_text: Append <fs> then unencrypted MMYY expiration date

requirements.statement: For TransArmor processing, expiration date must be stored for subsequent transactions with a token.
requirements.expected_behavior: Expiration date must be stored for subsequent transactions
requirements.constraint_text: Expiration date must be stored for subsequent transactions
